name: permission-request-chime-windows
description: Play a local Windows sound when Codex asks you to approve a permission request.

interface.shortDescription: Play a Windows chime when Codex asks for permission.
interface.longDescription: Permission Request Chime (Windows) bundles a Codex PermissionRequest lifecycle hook that plays a local Windows system sound when a request is routed to you for approval. Automatically reviewed requests stay silent. Install this version on Windows. macOS users should install Permission Request Chime (macOS).
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me configure the Windows permission request chime.
